title: the subprocess executor's pi runner has no gateway metering wiring
description:
dm2 wired the join into the herdr executor (the live local substrate for this epic) and the status-model reader. The local subprocess executor also launches pi (its runner table's pi row) and would need the same per-attempt extension appended to its resolved argv — it has no Metering option today, so a run dispatched through it still launches pi unjoined and its cost line stays honestly unmetered.
